title: 二本のオール付き木製ベンチ手漕ぎボート
description: 水辺や貸しボート置場に配置する開放型手漕ぎボート。丸い厚肉船殻と本当に凹んだ船内、曲がった肋材、持上げた床板、支持材付き二枚の座板、船縁・船底キール、金属オール受けに接する二本の柄と幅広い水かき、船首環を造形。オールを含む一式で1点。 最下点をY=0とする水平中央原点です。水面の高さ・喫水位置は配置側で選んでください。水・人物・物理挙動・操縦・浮力・流体力学・救助機能は含まず、静的外形のみです。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）4.243 × 1.055 × 3.632 m、10,268三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An open rowing boat for waterfront and rental-boathouse scenes. A rounded thick hull encloses a genuinely recessed interior, curved ribs, raised floorboards, two supported thwarts, timber gunwales and exterior keel. Two long oars with broad shaped blades rest in metal oarlocks; a small bow eye finishes the assembly. Both oars count within this one model. The horizontally centered origin places the lowest geometry point at Y=0; choose the waterline and immersion height in your own scene. No water, people, physics, driving, flotation, hydrodynamics or rescue functionality is included: this is a static exterior assembly. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 4.243 × 1.055 × 3.632 m; 10,268 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
